commands.doctor: Observe staged setup, exact HC context and registered role; writes nothing and never starts a core
commands.quota: Advisory provider quota. Codex uses Remainder. Other providers use quota-axi. Never switches accounts
commands.release-contract: Print this runtime's release contract; writes nothing
commands.init: Initialize the exact HC task role/attempt with matching native process and receipt evidence; without qualified HC context default to developer; coordinator initialization ensures the scoped observer unless explicitly disabled
commands.status: All recorded tasks from saved records, with outstanding maintenance and its commands; reads only, never delivers, calls GitHub, or cleans up
commands.inbox: Only tasks that need attention: questions, reports, errors, cleanup; reads only, like status
commands.skills: Check Sum-owned skill projections or copy explicit third-party skills into one project
commands.prepare: Coordinator only: record an approved task and create its isolated worktree (no launch)
commands.dispatch: Coordinator only: record an approved task and create its isolated worktree; then launch the worker
commands.start: Coordinator only: launch the worker for a prepared task once; never retries an uncertain launch; a recorded launch whose argv carries a permission/trust override the record did not authorize is refused before a terminal is created
commands.execution: Show, park, resume, or recover task-local execution reservations
commands.help: Concise command discovery: every command with one line, or `help TOPIC` (e.g. brief, brief-adopt) for its arguments
commands.context: Bounded selective read of one task: outline by default, --section for parts including saved GitHub review threads, --role for a role view, --since CURSOR for changes
commands.notes: Append one timestamped entry to the task's optional notes.md (a claim, backed up with the records; credentials refused)
commands.finding: Record and follow optional findings; only the registered coordinator may defer, dismiss, reopen, resolve, or link work
commands.env: Task-local environment record: declared dev commands, observed URLs/ports, log paths, terminal/container references; observes and records only
commands.show: Full task record plus versions, evidence_view, and returns (unchanged shape; use `context` for a bounded read)
commands.notice: Explicit single retry of the pending notice toward one recipient
commands.archive: Coordinator only: archive a task after every execution reservation was separately released
commands.ask: Worker: save a question before waiting; structured choices require one recommendation and rationale; human actions can include ordered steps, references, expected result, user report, and worker check; the parent is notified only after it is saved
commands.answer: Coordinator: record a listed or custom human decision, or --close an answer no worker can apply any longer
commands.explain: Coordinator: record a distinct clarification request for an open question and notify its worker; does not answer or close the question
commands.report: Worker: submit the report (and --handoff) as a claim for the coordinator to verify
commands.resolve: Worker: mark an answered question applied
commands.review: Reviewer terminal: append independent findings for one candidate, owed to the parent as a return until the coordinator acts on it; never replaces the worker report
commands.reviewer: Launch or recover an independent candidate-bound HC reviewer at the Git checkout
commands.verify: Coordinator only: append the coordinator's own verification result for one exact candidate (prose, --run run.json, or --execute)
commands.pr: Exact PR identity from an authenticated GitHub observation; never parsed from prose or guessed from branch names. The read is retried once, within the same bound, only for a positively transient gh failure (HTTP 5xx, 429, secondary rate limit, connection error); auth, 404, GraphQL, malformed output, and timeouts are never retried, and no write ever is
commands.pipeline: The delivery gates one task has passed, derived from its own records; the table states what has run at the instant it was observed, never that a change may merge
commands.cleanup: Inspect or apply guarded removal of exact owned native terminal/history and the verified merged Git worktree; preserve dirty/unmerged work, obligations, active attempts and unknown survivors
commands.pump: One budgeted delivery pass over saved pending returns: at most one coalesced notice per recipient, deferred recipients named; never calls GitHub or cleans up
commands.sweep: Coordinator only: explicit maintenance: one GitHub observation per recorded open PR, close of settled worker and reviewer terminals, and one guarded cleanup apply per pending task, least recently maintained first; starts nothing after its budget and names deferred tasks
commands.hook: Scoped non-agent HC event observer; coordinator init ensures a real startup/readiness receipt unless explicitly disabled; failure is fail-open and degraded
commands.metadata: Optional display-only owned HC labels on verified recorded terminals; never role, lifecycle or approval authority
commands.attention: Coordinator only: mark one native attention record seen after inspecting the pane; the record stays
commands.wake: Coordinator wake episodes (#240a) and decision priority (#240b): show every wake sidecar, the exact boundary of the outstanding work, and the decisions already prompted; consume one boundary after reading it; reconcile a prepared, interrupted, or replaced-occupant episode; never resends
commands.bind: Explicitly bind inspected HC parent/worker/reviewer identity and receipt evidence; never launches or grants authority from a label/address alone
commands.backup: Records-only tar.gz preserving task/procedure history and manifest; no worktree code or runtime authority. Import with restore ARCHIVE NEW_HOME into write-blocked quarantine
commands.settings: Show or set validated optional settings in .sum/settings.json; absent capacity is unlimited and absent evidence publishes into the PR
commands.preset: Named launch presets in .sum/settings.json: validated harness/model/argv shortcuts expanded at dispatch, not agents or roles
commands.project: Managed project clones: enroll exactly one repository under <installation>/projects/<owner>/<repo>, list, show, or inspect a migration; never a shared task checkout
commands.factory: Per-project software factory: enable a lane, tick for the next ready issue, claim it, and merge only at high confidence; never a daemon
commands.graph: Per-checkout code graph (pinned codegraph), built only on request: index one task's checkout, observe its freshness, or print an MCP snippet; never installs or configures globally
commands.lsp: Install allowlisted LSP binaries through mise into .local/bin; unknown binaries are refused; an existing link is never retargeted
commands.dev: Prepare, list, or remove isolated self-development checkouts of this installation
commands.brief: Inspect, regenerate, request, or adopt versioned worker brief revisions; the brief a worker reads is never rewritten
commands.refresh: Rolling refresh of running sessions: stage and request each target's next revision, attempt one bounded delivery, report status
commands.release: Stage, list, or inspect immutable runtime releases under .local/releases; staging never activates
commands.update: Check, stage, atomically apply, inspect, or roll back the installation default runtime; existing work keeps running
commands.usage: Opt-in per-task agent usage accounting over the Claude Code transcripts of the terminals Sum bound to one task; reports counts and coverage, never a bill, and never changes delivery or cleanup
commands.coordinator: Start a bound coordinator with exact HC identity, recorded launch environment and matching initialization receipt
commands.restore: Import records into a fresh schema-two backend:records quarantine; preserve task/procedure bytes, transfer no live authority and block all mutations
commands.delivery: Coordinator-only: durably resolve one exact historical delivery effect using existing matching application/consumed-boundary proof; sends nothing and preserves original effect/error

usage: sumctl help TOPIC for one command's arguments and subcommands
context: sumctl context TASK_ID [--section NAME ...] [--role worker|reviewer|coordinator] [--since CURSOR]

subcommands.reconcile: Coordinator only: inspect PR --number in the task repository with gh (one bounded retry of that read on a transient failure), record its exact identity, state, mismatches, and head-bound review threads, then publish the worker's before/after evidence
subcommands.evidence: Coordinator only: publish each evidence run's before/after media into the reconciled PR's marked block; receipts and publish copies stay under the task record

pipeline.help: The delivery gates one task has passed, derived from its own records; the table states what has run at the instant it was observed, never that a change may merge

subcommands.show: Print the recorded gates and the table; writes nothing
subcommands.refresh: Coordinator only: re-derive every gate from the task record
subcommands.run: Coordinator only: run the gates this terminal owns in order (rebase, test, lint, document, push, PR) and stop at the first failure or a blocked Test; --no-pr stops after push
subcommands.rebase: Coordinator only: observe the candidate against its base branch in a throwaway worktree; never rewrites the branch
subcommands.lint: Coordinator only: run the lint task the project itself declares against the candidate; a project that declares none is not-declared
subcommands.push: Coordinator only: fast-forward push the recorded branch to origin once the worker has reported, Rebase passes against a base fetched just now, and no required before/after evidence is missing; --allow-behind never waives a conflict; never forces
subcommands.pr: Coordinator only: fetch the base again, then open the PR for the pushed candidate as a draft, or adopt the one GitHub already has for that branch, and reconcile it; reconcile marks a draft ready when every delivery gate has settled; a candidate now behind (without --allow-behind) or conflicting is refused, and so is a branch with only closed PRs
subcommands.document: Coordinator only: audit the candidate's VERIFY.md and feature maps in a throwaway checkout and record the result
subcommands.ci: Coordinator only: read the checks and the mergeability GitHub reports on the reconciled PR and record what they said; observed at this instant, never watched, and republished unless --no-publish
subcommands.publish: Coordinator only: write the pipeline table into the reconciled PR's own marked block; --dry-run edits nothing
